title: How density, diversity, land use and neighborhood type influences bus mobility in the Swedish city of Karlstad: Mixing spatial analytic and typo-morphological approaches to assess the indirect effect of urban form on travel
venue_or_publisher: Journal of Transport and Land Use, 11(1)
tradition: 街區形態類型與公車移動
method: 空間分析結合 typo-morphological neighborhood 分類

claims.claim_zh: Karlstad 研究以建築類型、地塊大小、街道布局和土地使用描述街區類型，再分析都市型態與公車移動的關係。
claims.scope_zh: 研究尺度是街區型態及旅運分析；沒有把單棟建築內部的垂直混用當成主要測量對象。

query.author: Todor Stojanovski
